mapper.sql: SELECT p.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qms_inspection_plan_item i WHERE i.plan_id = p.id) AS item_count FROM qms_inspection_plan p LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = p.material_id
mapper.select: SELECT p.* FROM qms_inspection_plan p JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = #{materialId} LEFT JOIN wms_material_category pc ON pc.code = p.material_category LEFT JOIN wms_material_category mc ON mc.code = m.category WHERE p.insp_type = #{type} AND p.status = 1 AND (p.material_id = m.id OR (p.material_id IS NULL AND (p.material_category = m.category OR CONCAT(',', mc.ancestors, ',') LIKE CONCAT('%,', pc.id, ',%')))) ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.material_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN p.material_category = m.category THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, LENGTH(pc.ancestors) DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT 1
